blocks.head: alt The user is near the device
alt The user holds key and the device exists
alt Either user can make this request for the other user without prerequisites
alt Either user can make this request for the other user without prerequisites
alt The user is away from deviceB
alt The user is near the device

state_rules.rule:
eq < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : Owners , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'inviteUser' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY) 
= < cloudA | (UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ..) , ...) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev6
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev6]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev6(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev6
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev6]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > 
=> ep: ev6(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : (deviceB , Rest) , ..) > .
